integrity: The analytic theorem is supported by its displayed exact phase reduction, local uniform estimates, and a numerical reproducibility script; finite checks do not prove uniform asymptotics. Originating transmission formula and other prior art are cited. No independent scientific validation is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Only a two-pendant graph with fixed h=2 ell, theta=(1,1,sqrt(2)), positive Robin ratio and cellwise frequency norms; the result does not extend automatically to other graphs, nor establish a general Fano-line-shape theorem.
title: Quadratic-width Lorentzian transmission spikes and an \(L^p\) crossover in a Robin quantum graph
